text: Baghdadi Capital, S.A. describes itself as a 'global independent corporate and investment banking family office,' established in February 2023 by Spanish entrepreneur Baihas Baghdadi (who the firm describes as of Syrian heritage), and states it is a '100% Spanish family office.' The site makes no mention of any state or sovereign-fund involvement one way or the other.

source.name: Baghdadi Capital, S.A. official 'Who We Are' page
source.quote: In February 2023, Baghdadi Capital was established, a 100% Spanish family office founded by Baihas Baghdadi
